messages:
Hannah (Marketing): hey team :wave: need an omnichannel benchpack for the product launch next week. Deliverables: benchmark hero diagram for web + print, two webinar slides (intro + data), one-pager PDF, four social tiles (square + story), email header, and an SVG inbound-routing map for HubSpot. Target go-live: Tue EOD (2026-04-07). Can you confirm capacity and blockers?

Jules (Design): can pick this up. quick q — which benchmark metrics to show (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost per 1k)? also need final short copy for hero and slides, and any customer logos we plan to surface.

Hannah (Marketing): prioritize latency p50/p95 and cost per 1k tokens. copy: short headlines only, will paste below. logos: only approved partners from whitelist per Legal. tagging Sam for the raw numbers and a figma link.

Sam (Product): uploaded raw data to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-bench-data (CSV + spreadsheet + README). key numbers: p50=42ms, p95=120ms, gen cost=$0.007 per 1k tokens. included model variants and testbed notes.

Nina (Marketing Ops): for the inbound SVG: we map form -> segment -> SFDC lead -> campaign source. i need an SVG with labeled nodes and element IDs so HubSpot can map fields. sample mapping CSV:```FormField,SegmentName,SFDC_Field
email,Inbound - Webinar,Email
company,Inbound - Webinar,Company
benchmark_interest,Benchpack,Product_Interest__c```

Liam (Growth): short social copy ideas:
- Serving wins: lower latency, lower cost
- Benchmarked: 42ms p50, 120ms p95
CTAs: Join the webinar / See the benchpack

Jules (Design): timeline: hero diagram + webinar slides first (Mon WIP), then 1-pager + social tiles (Tue). file specs: hero web PNG 1400x800, hero print PDF 8.5x11, social 1200x1200 + 1080x1920 story, email header 600x200, and SVG routing file. export names: bench-hero-web.png, bench-hero-print.pdf, bench-webinar-1.pdf, bench-webinar-2.pdf, bench-1pager.pdf, bench-social-1.png etc.

Hannah (Marketing): need localization in en, fr, de. can design leave editable text layers and we'll drop translated copy as separate files with locale suffixes?

Jules (Design): yes — will produce EN masters with editable text layers and export locale-suffixed files when translations are provided. designers need translated strings as separate files tagged _fr and _de.

Legal (Legal): quick compliance note — do not use customer logos without written approval. partner logos OK if on approved whitelist. also avoid wording that could be read as an SLA. use qualifiers like 'benchmarked' or 'measured in our testbeds'. Sam, please ensure README language reflects this.

Sam (Product): added README in Drive: measured under internal testbed conditions; not an SLA.

Nina (Marketing Ops): for HubSpot mapping, include element ids on exported SVG like id=form-email, id=segment-webinar, id=sfdc-email. i will provide a mapping CSV once i see ids.

Jules (Design): will include id attributes on export. sharing a figma WIP link Mon morning: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/omnichannel-benchpack (comment-only). WIP ETA Mon 09:00 PT.

Hannah (Marketing): priority order: 1) hero diagram + webinar slides 2) inbound-routing SVG 3) 1-pager PDF 4) social tiles + email header. keep me posted on any blockers. :thumbsup:

Jules (Design): WIP Mon 09:00 PT, final assets by Tue 14:00 PT. will upload exports to shared Drive and tag @Hannah when ready.

Liam (Growth): i'll drop short alt copy and a 2-line webinar blurb in the Drive tonight for localization.

Hannah (Marketing): great — once WIP is up i'll run a brand-compliance sweep and loop Legal if needed.

Jules (Design): got it. will ping here if copy changes.
